kind: actual Expo UI with isolated PostgreSQL and Redis
browser: Chromium, separate rider and driver sessions

checks.name: both assigned participants load the real chat UI
rider sends and driver receives one persisted message
driver replies and rider receives it
read receipts appear in both sessions
offline send stays pending then reconnects without duplicates

dataIsolation: Disposable database and Redis; external browser requests blocked; no real users, SMS or push delivery.
